config.dragit.width.name: Max Width
config.dragit.width.tooltip: The maximum rendering width of chat images in pixels. Images are scaled proportionally, so this does not stretch or distort them.
config.dragit.height.name: Max Height
config.dragit.height.tooltip: The maximum rendering height of chat images in pixels. Images are scaled proportionally, so this does not stretch or distort them.
config.dragit.pixels.name: Max Pixels
config.dragit.pixels.tooltip: The maximum renderable pixels of chat images. Images would be compressed and lose details if you decrease this value. Performance impact is mainly about network sync, not client rendering
